title_original: Millions of security cameras at risk: DoS vulnerability in Intelbras devices
description: During our research, we discovered a denial-of-service vulnerability that could affect millions of Intelbras IP camera systems built on the platform platform of a popular Chinese manufacturer.

title_original: PHP2Shell: Exploitation Attempts and Remediation Trends
description: Wiz research has been monitoring PHP2Shell exploitation attempts, but none have succeeded so far. We examine the techniques used, what prevented the attacks from completing and how observed exposure has changed since disclosure.

title_original: Yoba Malware Abuses Signed ChatGPT and Claude Binaries to Target AI Users
description: As interest in new AI tools accelerates, cybercriminals are finding ways to exploit the trust surrounding them. Check Point Research (CPR) has uncovered Yoba, a malware campaign using fake GitHub projects impersonating supposed ChatGPT and Claude desktop applications, while abusing legitimate, signed OpenAI and Anthropic executables to help load malware. The campaign shows how the rush to access new AI tools is creating opportunities for social engineering, even when the AI platforms themselves have not been compromised. Key Findings Attackers used fake GitHub projects impersonating supposed ChatGPT and Claude desktop applications to distribute Yoba malware.
